ev.q: Nearly 93% of households reported hurricane-related damage.
Approximately 90% of households were in compliance with a public health advisory for drinking bottled water.
Nearly 48% of households surveyed were in mobile homes, and 19% of all households reported uninhabitable homes.
Charlotte County DeSoto County Hardee County
Assessment teams administered a questionnaire to household respondents

methods_quotes.q: weighted cluster analysis was conducted by using SAS and SUDAAN
Census blocks within each county were grouped into clusters of five and weighted by the number of housing units with an older adult resident
The clusters were representative of 38,301 (Charlotte), 4,909 (DeSoto), and 3,134 (Hardee) housing units with an older adult resident.
